/* POKEMON TORRE V35.9 — 8 DIREÇÕES + GOLPES FORTES CORRIGIDOS
 * PMDCollab sprite-sheet order: 0 S, 1 SE, 2 E, 3 NE, 4 N, 5 NW, 6 W, 7 SW.
 * Direction is taken from true movement in the arena; Attack faces its target.
 * No more fixed row 4 (back pose) while idle. */
function v354Dir8(dx,dy){
 if(!Number.isFinite(dx)||!Number.isFinite(dy)||Math.hypot(dx,dy)<.01)return 0;
 return ((Math.round(Math.atan2(dx,dy)/(Math.PI/4))%8)+8)%8;

function v354DirectionalRow(actor,isEnemy,opponent,now,action,moving,rows){

 // Keyboard / joystick input includes 8 diagonals; core drawMon observes this frame.
 if(isPlayer&&engineNow){
  const keys=engineNow.keys||new Set(),joy=engineNow.input||{dx:0,dy:0};
  const kx=(keys.has('d')||keys.has('arrowright')?1:0)-(keys.has('a')||keys.has('arrowleft')?1:0);
  const ky=(keys.has('s')||keys.has('arrowdown')?1:0)-(keys.has('w')||keys.has('arrowup')?1:0);

  actor.v354Direction=v354Dir8(dx,dy);actor.v354DirectionAt=now;

  const ax=(opponent?.x??actor.x)-actor.x,ay=(opponent?.y??actor.y)-actor.y;
  if(Math.hypot(ax,ay)>1)actor.v354Direction=v354Dir8(ax,ay);

 if(action==='Idle' && (!actor.v354DirectionAt || now-actor.v354DirectionAt>1600)){
  const ax=(opponent?.x??actor.x)-actor.x,ay=(opponent?.y??actor.y)-actor.y;
  actor.v354Direction=isEnemy?v354Dir8(ax,ay):0;
 }
 const row=actor.v354Direction??0;

 if(engineNow){engineNow.v354Directions??={player:0,enemy:0};engineNow.v354Directions[isEnemy?'enemy':'player']=row;}

 if(!b?.active||b.paused||!this.running||m.hp<=0||i<0||i>3)return false;

 if(b.energy<(s.cost||0)){log('Energia insuficiente para '+s.name+'.');return false;}

 const fx=begin(this,s,fire?'fire':'leaves',now,from,to,{v354Special:fire?'fireblast':'petaldance'});
 fx.end=now+(fire?1230:1490);
 this.v354SpecialAttacks||=[];

  hitAt:fire?[now+730]:[now+530,now+860,now+1190],done:0,fx});

const v354OldUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){

 if(!battle?.active)return res;
 this.v354SpecialAttacks=(this.v354SpecialAttacks||[]).filter(c=>{
  if(c.battle!==battle||current()!==c.attacker||foe()!==c.target||c.target.hp<=0)return false;
  while(c.done<c.hitAt.length && now>=c.hitAt[c.done]){
   if(this.enemy?.inv>0 && now-c.hitAt[c.done]<540)break;
   const before=c.target.hp;
   this.hitTarget('enemy',c.move.type,c.fire?c.move.power:Math.max(14,Math.round(c.move.power*.47)));
   c.done++;
   if(c.target.hp<before){

   }

  }
  return c.done<c.hitAt.length && now-c.at<2200 && foe()===c.target;

};

/* V35.60 — Progressao real do catalogo e bloqueio por nivel. Nenhum efeito visual de golpe e alterado. */
(function(){
 const previousCatalog=v32Catalogue;
 const firstSkills=v32BaseSkills;
 const minByPower=p=>p<=20?1:p<=30?5:p<=35?12:p<=40?19:p<=45?27:p<=50?35:p<=55?43:p<=60?52:p<=70?63:74;
 function required(entry){
   const m=entry.move||{},power=Math.max(0,Number(m.power)||0),min=Number(entry.level)||1;
   let level=power?minByPower(power):((m.kind==='recover'||m.kind==='hazard')?26:((Number(m.cost)||0)>=28?17:5));
   if(m.kind==='homing')level=Math.max(level,33);
   if(m.kind==='area'&&power>30)level=Math.max(level,21);
   if(m.kind==='beam'&&power>40)level=Math.max(level,32);
   // A trilha de nivel ja existente e respeitada, mas um golpe forte nao cai para Nv.1.
   return Math.min(100,Math.max(min,level));
 }
 function ensureBasic(pool,m){
   let choices=pool.filter(x=>x.available);

   const home=firstSkills(m),t=D[m.id].type;
   const make=(name,type,power,kind,cost,icon)=>({name,type,power,kind,cost,icon,cat:power?'physical':'status',cd:kind==='shield'?4700:kind==='dash'?1500:2300});
   const options=[
      home[0],
      make('Investida','normal',18,'dash',0,'✹'),
      make('Arranhão','normal',19,'dash',0,'✷'),
      make('Concentrar','normal',0,'shield',14,'✧'),
      make('Golpe Inicial',t,22,'bolt',12,V32_ADD_MOVES[t]?.icon||'✦')
   ];
   for(const move of options){
      if(pool.filter(x=>x.available).length>=4)break;
      if(!move?.name)continue;
      const key=v32MoveKey(move);
      if(pool.some(x=>x.key===key)){
        // Preserve existing entries; only the first elementary move can unlock early.
        const found=pool.find(x=>x.key===key);
        if(found && (move.name==='Investida'||move.name==='Arranhão'||move.name==='Concentrar'||move.name==='Golpe Inicial')){found.level=1;found.tm=false;found.available=true;}
        continue;
      }
      pool.push({key,move:{...move},level:1,tm:false,available:true});
   }
   return pool;
 }
 let catalogCount=0,blockedAt5=0,adjustedSaves=0;
 v32Catalogue=function(m){

     pool.push({key:v32MoveKey(fm),move:fm,level:12,tm:false,available:level>=12});

        const kept=new Set(); if(typed)kept.add(typed.key);
        for(const x of available){if(kept.size>=4)break;kept.add(x.key);}
